chunks: From him, from his father, from Fazalat ibn Ayyub, from Al-Hasan ibn Ziyad Al-Sayqal, from Fuzayl ibn Yasar, who said:
Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) said: 'The most difficult of the worship is the devoutness (war').'
ai.seo_question: What is considered the most difficult form of worship in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In *Al-Kafi*, Imam al-Baqir (peace be upon him) identifies *al-wara'* (scrupulous piety) as the pinnacle of worship, distinguishing it from mere ritual observance by highlighting the internal vigilance required to avoid doubtful matters. This hadith underscores the Shia emphasis on inner spiritual purity and conscious avoidance of sin as the true measure of a believer's devotion, a concept deeply rooted in the teachings of the Ahl al-Bayt regarding the refinement of the soul.
